multiple.description: Whether multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

collapsible.description: Whether an accordion item can be closed after it has been expanded.

value.description: The controlled value of the expanded accordion items.

default-value.description:
The initial value of the expanded accordion items.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the accordion.

disabled.description: Whether the accordion items are disabled

orientation.description: The orientation of the accordion items.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

valuechange.description: Fired when the state of expanded/collapsed accordion items changes.

focuschange.description: Fired when the focused accordion item changes.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the accordion. Useful for composition.

value.description: The controlled value of the expanded accordion items.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

value.description: The value of the accordion item.

disabled.description: Whether the accordion item is disabled.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
